## 📄 Which Article?

Please paste the URL of the article with the correction needed.

Example: https://bandwar.vercel.app/article/shivala

---

## 🔍 What Needs Correction?

Describe the specific error. Please quote the exact text.

**Current text:**
> "..."

**Corrected text:**
> "..."

---

## ✅ Source / Verification

How do you know this is correct?

- [ ] I am a resident of Bandwar
- [ ] I am a descendant of a Bandwar resident
- [ ] I have access to a document (please describe)
- [ ] I have access to a photograph (please attach)
- [ ] Other: ___________

Please provide any evidence — links, documents, photos, or reference to a person who can verify.

---

## 📚 Additional Context

Any other information that might help us verify this correction.

---

## 📸 Attachments

If you have photos, documents, or screenshots, please attach them.

---

## ⚠️ Important Note

**We take corrections seriously.** Every correction is reviewed and verified
before being applied. Please be patient with the review process.

If your correction is verified, you will be credited in the article.

---

## ✋ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have provided a source or verification method
- [ ] I understand this correction will be verified before publishing
- [ ] I consent to being credited (or I prefer to remain anonymous)
